definitions.explanation: An individual unit of language that carries meaning; also refers to vocabulary in general.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{単語|たんご}を{覚|おぼ}える。
この{単語|たんご}の{意味|いみ}が{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I don't understand the meaning of this word.

examples.japanese: {単語帳|たんごちょう}を{使|つか}って{勉強|べんきょう}している。
examples.english: I'm studying using a vocabulary notebook.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単語|たんご}を{覚|おぼ}える (to memorize words)
- {単語|たんご}を{調|しら}べる (to look up a word)
- {単語帳|たんごちょう} (vocabulary notebook/flashcards)
- {単語|たんご}テスト (vocabulary test)

RELATED TERMS:
- {語彙|ごい} (vocabulary - formal/academic)
- {言葉|ことば} (word, language - broader meaning)
- {熟語|じゅくご} (compound word, idiom)

LANGUAGE LEARNING:
- {基本単語|きほんたんご} (basic vocabulary)
- {必須単語|ひっすたんご} (essential vocabulary)
